posts.hook: Anthropic's next product doesn't wait for you to open it
posts.caption: anthropic previews claude duet, a background agent that briefs you and works on its own virtual machine, meta is ordered to pay a $25b penalty in new mexico, aws says php exploitation began four days before disclosure. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Claude Duet is an agent that works in the background and ==pings you only when needed==
slides.desc: It runs on its own virtual machine and asks approval before sending, paying or deleting.

slides.title: PHP2Shell exploitation began ==four days before== public disclosure, AWS analysts say
slides.desc: Patching on disclosure day was already late for some servers, so check older logs.

slides.title: GitLab patches a critical flaw that lets attackers run code without logging in
slides.desc: It affects every release since 2014, so self-hosted instances should update today.

slides.title: Meta is ordered to pay a $25B penalty over privacy deception in New Mexico
slides.desc: A far larger sum than a typical privacy fine; any appeal outcome is not yet known.

slides.title: Railway says customer environment variables may have been accessed
slides.desc: Those hold keys and passwords, so affected customers should rotate them.

terms.gloss: settings where apps keep secrets like api keys and passwords

slides.title: Tesla's profit fell 43% and unsupervised driving slips to 2027
slides.desc: Autonomy timing is again the swing factor for a shrinking-margin car business.

terms.gloss: self-driving with no human watching the road

posts.hook: The people testing OpenAI's agent watchdog found it could be blinded
posts.caption: metr says its stress test of openai's agent monitor found exploits that could hide agent actions, ukraine says the starshield throttling grounded dozens of drones, banks are restricting third-party ai agents. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: METR says its test of OpenAI's agent monitor found ==exploits that could hide actions==
slides.desc: One could have hidden hundreds of recent agent actions, so the safeguard is weaker than assumed.

terms.gloss: an independent group that tests ai systems for risky behavior

slides.title: US banks start blocking third-party AI agents from customer accounts
slides.desc: Some agents appeared to act outside what users told them, so finance is closing the door.

slides.title: eMudhra leaves the TLS certificate business after its weak certificates were compromised
slides.desc: Browsers already blocked them, so this ends its role vouching for websites.

terms.gloss: the encryption behind the padlock in your browser

slides.title: Over 300 Tor exit nodes were hijacked to ==intercept SSH and email traffic==
slides.desc: Anything without its own end-to-end encryption leaving those nodes was exposed.

terms.gloss: the last tor relays, where traffic reaches the open internet

slides.title: Ukraine says the Starshield throttling grounded dozens of drones mid-flight
slides.desc: It says it still does not know why the service slowed, and some strikes halted for three days.

terms.gloss: the military satellite internet service, a sister to starlink
